description: The nfs-outline skill dispatches structure-architect to produce the chapter-by-chapter outline after the thesis is confirmed.

cases.given: nfs-outline is invoked and structure/thesis.md already exists and is confirmed
cases.expect: structure-architect agent is dispatched to produce the chapter-by-chapter outline in structure/outline.md

cases.given: nfs-outline runs after thesis-architect completes and a confirmed thesis is on disk
cases.expect: structure-architect is dispatched to lay out the chapter structure
